title: Michael Jackson Hee-Hee
blurb: No vocal ad-lib in pop history is more famous, and it now does service as an all-purpose exclamation of flair. Michael Jackson used it as punctuation, a rhythmic hiccup between lines that meant nothing on its own and existed purely for the percussion of it, so it lifts out of the music very cleanly. Anything performed with a bit of extra style has earned it: a smooth move, a dramatic exit, a burst of confidence nobody has verified. Play it when somebody does something completely ordinary with unnecessary panache. Undefeated as a stylistic full stop.
origin: Michael Jackson's signature vocal ad-lib, meme shorthand for doing anything with flair.
